ID: `html-show`.

## What it does

Chooses between a feature summary, competitive research, current-state audit and concept explanation. Reads sources, selects the relevant template and prepares a single HTML file with embedded CSS and JavaScript. Can use before/after comparisons, filters, galleries and image zoom when they clarify the content. Verifies navigation, images and readability on desktop, intermediate widths and mobile.

## When to use it

Use it to present research, redesign results or a concept in a navigable page that opens locally. It is not a slide deck and does not replace canonical operational documentation.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/html-show` in Claude Code or `$html-show` in Codex. Provide materials, audience and the decision to discuss. Specify the presentation type and save path if already decided. Include sources and before/after images; request a page with real content and controls that have a useful effect.

## What it delivers

- Standalone HTML file
- Linked sources and assets
- Verification of the requested controls and layouts

## Example

Prepare an HTML page comparing the three onboarding patterns from the research, with screenshots, sources and selection criteria.
